summary: TFI International Inc. filed a Form 6-K on April 20, 2026, reminding shareholders of its upcoming Annual Meeting of Shareholders scheduled for April 27, 2026. The filing is a routine notice of a shareholder meeting, including dial-in details and voting instructions. No special-situation event — such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change — is disclosed. This is a standard procedural communication without any terms, recommendations, advisors, or structural mechanics. There are no deal terms to report.
